crossRefs.note: “Son of man, I have made you a watchman to the house of Israel. Therefore hear the word from my mouth, and warn them…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I…
Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who…
For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
translations.bsb: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus.
translations.kjv: For ye know what commandments we gave you by the Lord Jesus.
translations.asv: For ye know what charge we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
